horoscopes.title: Aries Weekly Horoscope Starting October 18
content: This week may see a continuation of themes from the previous week, influenced by Mars remaining in Leo. Focus on children's academic pursuits and future planning may require significant attention this week. Financial allocations towards educational fees, courses, or extracurricular engagements for children may be necessary. Individuals in partnerships may encounter minor disagreements, often stemming from previously unaddressed concerns. Contact from a past romantic acquaintance could lead to unanticipated discussions. Students are likely to achieve positive examination results, despite potential disruptions during preparation. Creative endeavors may not yield expected outcomes; therefore, prudence is advised regarding significant investments in speculative projects.

Financial matters will be a key area of focus this week. Discussions with a partner about shared expenses or outstanding financial commitments are likely. Some individuals may experience unexpected financial gains from sources like insurance claims or settlements. Information previously held private by a family member could be revealed. Updates regarding loan applications are also expected. For couples, the current astrological climate supports the resolution of any ongoing issues.

Your partner may have increased influence in family decisions this week, particularly regarding finances, travel, or relatives, as the Sun completes its transit through Libra. A previously discussed decision may resurface, leading to considerable dialogue between you and your partner. For those in business partnerships, discussions may arise concerning adjustments to responsibilities or profit distribution. Some may meet with an important client or senior official to discuss a pending agreement. Unmarried individuals might receive a marriage proposal through family connections. A business transaction is set to advance, although certain conditions will require additional discussion before formalization.

horoscopes.title: Taurus Weekly Horoscope Starting October 18
content: Family matters will require significant attention this week. Expect home repairs or maintenance that may lead to unexpected expenses. These issues could also relate to property or vehicles. Discussions about family decisions may involve strong opinions from your mother, potentially leading to difficult conversations. Anticipate family meetings and problem-solving discussions. Individuals taking interviews or competitive examinations are likely to receive encouraging news. Some may need to visit a medical facility for a health issue that has been bothering them.

Your spouse will bring up a matter that both of you have been avoiding for some time Mercury and Venus shows solution for these issues. It will involve family responsibilities, money, or plans for the coming months. Couples who have been living apart for work will arrange a visit. Those looking for marriage alliances will hear from a family that had previously shown interest. Business owners will meet new customers, and a conversation with an old contact will turn into a useful opportunity. Some will sign an agreement or begin working with a new business partner. A family gathering will also bring you into contact with people you have not seen recently.

The solar transit will leave Libra this week, but before that you have to complete some important projects at work. Those employed in government departments or large organisations will receive updates about transfers, pending applications, or changes in duties. Money will go towards household purchases, medical bills, or vehicle repairs. A payment you have been waiting for will arrive after a few reminders. Those involved in legal disputes will have discussions with lawyers or concerned parties. Your spouse will help you settle an important matter. Towards the weekend, relatives will visit or invite you to a family function.

horoscopes.title: Gemini Weekly Horoscope Starting October 18
content: Martian transit through Leo is on and it is triggering the third house so, you will be very busy. Some of these trips will be connected to your work, while others will involve family responsibilities. Your siblings will have something important to discuss, possibly regarding money, property, or a decision concerning your parents. Those working in media, sales, marketing, and communication-related fields will receive new assignments. You will also hear from people you have not contacted for a long time. Some will purchase a new phone or electronic device, while others will spend money on vehicle maintenance.

Transit Mercury and Venus are moving through the sixth house, so there will be some creative projects. Both the planets will help you in solving the workplace issues and you will be able to have a good environment at work, There are chances for new job opportunities as well, so prepared for interviews as well. The only problem will be your bad diet as both planets will make you eat a lot, and thus they will being health issues.

The Sun is all set to leave Libra next week, so you have some important things to do worth your creative skills. If you are a parent, you will be taking additional responsibilities for children. Those preparing for competitive examinations will receive important updates regarding schedules or results. People working in teaching, entertainment, or creative fields will complete an important assignment but that will be very difficult as well. Those in romantic relationships will have conversations about their future together. Some will attend cultural programmes, school functions, or family celebrations. An investment made earlier will also come up for review.

horoscopes.title: Cancer Weekly Horoscope Starting October 18
content: For Cancer Sun, Moon and rising signs, the financial matters are important this week also as Mars is still in Leo. Mars itself is the planet for financial liabilities, so you will have a lot of financial needs. If you are impatient, there will be heated arguments at home. There will be natural delay in getting payments, but that doesn’t mean you will run out of cash. Those running family businesses will discuss income, outstanding payments, and new purchases. You will also attend a family gathering where an important decision will be discussed. Some will receive money that has been pending for a long time.

Mercury and Venus will bring some pleasant developments concerning your children, education, and personal interests. Parents will receive good news about their children's studies or achievements. Some will spend money on admission fees, coaching classes, or activities their children have recently taken up. Those in romantic relationships will have more opportunities to meet and spend time together. A conversation about marriage or the future of a relationship will also take place. Elders will surely support the children. If you are working in entertainment, you will get more opportunities. Some will attend cultural programmes, celebrations, or events involving children and young people.

The Sun will leave Libra this week, but before that, you will have to attend to certain matters at home. A pending repair, property document, or discussion about your living arrangements will need your attention. Your mother or an elderly family member will have an important role in a decision concerning the household. This is the time to meet brokers, real estate agents, or interior designers, but make sure you get the right deal. The Sun is debilitated, so it will good to cross check your decision to relocate. A family member's health will require attention, and some will accompany a relative to a medical appointment.

horoscopes.title: Leo Weekly Horoscope Starting October 18
content: For Leo Sun, Moon and rising signs, Mars is still in Leo, so you will have a lot of things to handle this week. This Mars will increase your impatience and that will create some problems. You will try to improve your appearance, so you will go for a makeover. There will be arguments with your spouse or business partners, and some of them will be over very small matters. Those who are planning to start a business or take up a new responsibility will make some important moves. You will also be concerned about your health, as headaches, body pain, or minor injuries will trouble some of you.

Mercury and Venus will bring more attention to your home and family matters. There will be discussions about buying a vehicle, changing the interiors, or making some improvements to your house. Your mother will have something important to discuss with you, and it will mostly concern family responsibilities or property matters. Those looking for a new house will visit a few places and compare the prices. If you are planning to sell property, you will hear from interested buyers. Some will welcome relatives who are coming from another place. Those staying away from their hometown will also make plans to visit their parents.

The Sun will leave Libra this week, but before that, you will have to complete some important work related to documents, travel, or communication. Since the Sun is debilitated in Libra, there will be delays in getting responses from officials or people in authority. Those waiting for approvals, certificates, or other documents will have to follow up more than once. Your siblings will have some news to share, and some of you will have to help them with a personal matter. Those working in sales, media, writing, or marketing will have more assignments and short trips. Some will attend interviews or meet people regarding a new job opportunity.

horoscopes.title: Virgo Weekly Horoscope Starting October 18
content: You need to be very mindful about your expenses, as Mars is moving through the twelfth house of losses. Some of these expenses will be related to travel, medical treatment, or the needs of family members. Those working abroad or trying to move to another country will have some important developments regarding their applications or job opportunities. If you are waiting for a visa or work permit, there will be further communication from the concerned authorities. Sleep will also be disturbed, mainly because of work pressure or personal worries .Many of you will opt for spending time in prayer and isolation.

There will be a lot of work these days as Mercury and Venus are moving through the water sign of Scorpio. Those working in writing, media, marketing, sales, or online businesses will receive new assignments. If you have been planning to start a YouTube channel, website, or another online activity, you will begin working on it. Your siblings will have some good news to share, possibly regarding their career or personal life. During this week, you will purchase electronic gadgets as well. You will also get opportunities to learn new skills, and attend a lot of online meetings.

The Sun will leave Libra this week, but before that, financial and family matters will need your attention. Since the Sun is debilitated in Libra, there will be some disagreements over money, family responsibilities, or pending payments. Those running family businesses will have to review their income and expenses. Since the Sun is debilitated, so there will be some issues in the workplace as welt his is not the right time to start or break your savings. Debilitated Sun can also bring unwanted speech.

horoscopes.title: Libra Weekly Horoscope Starting October 18
content: For Libra Sun, Moon and rising signs, Mars is still in Leo, so there will be a lot of activities connected to your income, friends and professional contacts. The eleventh house is connected to gains, so those running businesses will get new orders, but there will be some arguments with clients over payments. If you are expecting a salary hike or promotion, you will hear some news about it. Your elder siblings will also have some important matters to discuss with you. Some will join new organisations or become active in social groups. Please avoid any financial transactions with friends, otherwise it will create long term liabilities.

The Sun is debilitated in Libra, and it will leave your sign this week, so you will have to deal with some personal and professional challenges before that. Your health will need attention, especially if you have been ignoring minor complaints. This transit also will impact your appearance, and you will go for makeover. If you are holding a responsible position, there will be pressure from management or people in authority. This solar return will remind you the need of personal growth so there will be some discussions about your career, and some will seriously consider changing their present job. Your relationship with your spouse will need attention, as small disagreements will turn into unnecessary arguments.

Mercury and Venus will bring some relief in financial matters, as both planets will be in your second house. You will have discussions about savings, family expenses and investments. Some will receive pending payments, while others will get financial help from their family members. Those working in teaching, writing, banking, finance or business will have opportunities to increase their income. There will be expenses connected to jewellery, clothes or family celebrations. Family members will come together to discuss an important matter, possibly connected to property or marriage. Some will receive good news about a family member's career or financial situation.

horoscopes.title: Scorpio Weekly Horoscope Starting October 18
content: Your career is highly important despite you being Scorpio Sun, Moon or rising sign, as Mars is in Leo. Those looking for a job change will attend interviews or receive calls from recruiters. If you are running a business, there will be discussions about new projects, contracts and expansion plans. Some will have arguments with senior officials, especially over deadlines or work allocation. Those working in technical fields, engineering, and administration or government departments will have a particularly busy schedule.

The Sun is debilitated in Libra, and it will leave this sign during the week, so there will be some expenses and concerns related to matters that are not entirely under your control. The twelfth house is connected to foreign countries, hospitals and expenses, so those trying to move abroad will receive updates regarding visas, interviews or other formalities. Some will have to visit a hospital for themselves or a family member. There will also be expenses connected to travel, accommodation or pending bills. Those involved in legal matters will have to spend money on documentation or professional fees. Sleep will be disturbed for some, especially because of work pressure.

Mercury and Venus will be in your sign, so you will become more involved in your personal plans, relationships and appearance. You are naturally a bit reserved person, but both the planets will bring constructive communication. Single natives will have the closest time to find someone special. Some will spend money on clothes, grooming or personal purchases. Those working in media, writing, designing, consulting or business will receive appreciation for their ideas. Your spouse will also have an important role in a personal decision. People will notice you more than before.

horoscopes.title: Sagittarius Weekly Horoscope Starting October 18
content: For Sagittarius Sun, Moon and rising signs, Mars is still in Leo, so there will be more activities connected to long-distance travel, higher education and matters involving your father. There will be plans for long trips, and it can be for personal matters as well. Students will get some updates about their enrolment and courses. Mars is a natural malefic so, there will be issues with elders, especially mentors. If you are involved in a legal dispute, there will be discussions with lawyers regarding the next steps. Those working in teaching, publishing or research will have new assignments. Kindly avoid arguments regarding and philosophy.

Before debilitated leaves Libra, you will have to attend to some important matters concerning your income, friendships and professional contacts. Those waiting for salary increments, incentives or business payments will receive updates, but the actual money will take some more time to arrive. There will be some social gatherings, networking events and you will also join a new team. Some will have disagreements with friends over money or promises that were not kept. Your elder siblings will also have something to discuss, possibly concerning a family expense or an important decision. If you are involved in politics, social organisations or community activities, you will have more meetings to attend.

Mercury and Venus will be in your twelfth house, so foreign connections, travel expenses and private matters will become important this week. You will also spend money on comforts, clothes or things you have wanted to buy for some time. Couples living in different places will make arrangements to meet, while others will plan a private holiday. Some will hear from an old romantic interest, and the conversation will bring back matters that were never properly settled. Those working in hospitals, hotels, international trade or multinational companies will have more responsibilities. There will also be expenses connected to medical treatment or the needs of a family member.

horoscopes.title: Capricorn Weekly Horoscope Starting October 18
content: For Capricorn Sun, Moon and rising signs, Mars is still in Leo, so financial matters involving other people will need more attention this week. The eighth house is a complex house, so financial liabilities will be surely coming up. If you have applied for a loan or insurance claim, you will receive updates, but there will be more paperwork to complete. There will be some discussions with your in laws regarding joint accounts. You will also have to be careful while driving, as Mars in the eighth house will increase the chances of minor accidents or injuries. Sudden need of money will arise, and you will get a part time project to make some money too.

Your career also need more focus as the Sun is in the tenth house, but debilitated. If you are unhappy with your present job, there will be discussions about moving to another organisation. Some will have to explain delays or mistakes in their work, especially when management asks for updates. Business owners will meet officials or clients regarding contracts and pending approvals. Your father will also have some matters to discuss with you, possibly regarding his health or professional responsibilities. Those working in government departments will have additional duties or changes in their schedules.

Mercury and Venus will be in your eleventh house, so there will be some encouraging developments related to income, friendships and professional contacts. Those running businesses will receive enquiries from new customers, and some will finalise deals that have been under discussion for several weeks. If you are waiting for incentives, commissions or outstanding payments, you will hear good news. Friends and former colleagues will contact you with information about job openings or business opportunities. There will be some good time with your elder siblings. Social gatherings, networking, online and offline group conversations will be the part of this transit.

horoscopes.title: Aquarius Weekly Horoscope Starting October 18
content: For Aquarius Sun, Moon and rising signs, Mars is still in Leo, so marriage and business partnerships will need a lot of attention this week. There will be important matters to discuss with your spouse. If you are running a business with a partner, there will be disagreements over work allocation, payments or future plans. Those looking for marriage alliances will receive proposals, but some discussions will not go as expected. You will also meet people who are interested in working with you on new projects. Those dealing with clients will have to answer several questions before an agreement is finalised. A pending legal matter involving a partnership or contract will also come up for discussion.

Those planning to travel abroad will have to complete some paperwork or make changes to their travel arrangements as the Sun is in your ninth house. Students will get some updates about the fees and other matters from universities. Some will have differences of opinion with their father or another elderly family member, especially over career choices or financial decisions. Those involved in legal matters will have meetings with lawyers or officials, and there will be expenses connected to documentation. People working in teaching, publishing or research will have to complete an important assignment before the deadline
Your career will be very important for the next few weeks as Mercury and Venus are in the tenth house. Venus is retrograding now and Mercury will turn retrograde soon, so be careful with your career. Retrograde Venus is not so bad, but once when Mercury start its retrograde, things can go wrong, so you should crosscheck before the submission. Business owners will receive enquiries about their services, and a discussion with a prospective customer will lead to a new project. Those planning to start an independent business or consultancy will begin contacting potential clients. Some will also receive support from women in senior positions.

horoscopes.title: Pisces Weekly Horoscope Starting October 18
content: Your workplace is triggered by Mars in Leo, so get ready for some showdowns. There will be competition at the workplace, and some colleagues will not be happy with the decisions you make. If you have been facing problems with a co-worker, another incident will bring the matter to the attention of your manager. This is the closest time to get job calls. The lower abdomen is also sensitive so, take care of your diet. Some will have to take a family member to the hospital.

The Sun is debilitated in Libra, and it will leave this sign during the week, so there will be some developments concerning joint finances, insurance, taxes and other pending financial matters. If you have been waiting for an insurance settlement or reimbursement, you will have to contact the concerned office again. Some will discuss loans, debts or shared expenses with their spouse. There will also be conversations about inheritance or property belonging to the family. Please make sure your financial records are correct. Otherwise there will be issues, which can create long term blocks.

The ninth house is active, so, there will be foreign collaborations. Mercury and Venus are in the ninth house, so you will get some positive updates about studies. Some will travel to another city for interviews, training programmes or professional meetings. This is a good time for teachers and publishers as their work will get noticed. Your father or another senior family member will have good news to share, and some will receive financial support from their family. Long trips and global ventures will be the part of this transit. Some will also attend religious or cultural events with relatives. A conversation with a teacher, mentor or former colleague will help you move forward with a plan that has been pending for some time.
